output.title: BR-14 a proposal under the minimum amount is deferred and its entries stay unbilled
output.data_choice: P-1020 is an active project, so the closing exception does not apply. With period end 2026-10-01 it has only one entry, 0.25 h at the 150.00 EUR senior rate, which is 37.50 EUR: below the 50.00 EUR minimum but above 5.00 EUR. If the minimum were lowered to 5 EUR, that entry would be billed in the first proposal and would not reappear, so the second proposal would have one line instead of two.
